title: Check the workspace from the command line
steps: On a temporary product, runs lathe check with an unused view, then with --json.
Removes the view and checks again; then breaks a data file and checks.
expected_result: Expects errors, warnings and coverage in order with status 1, status 0 once fixed, and only a data-refused error naming the file and line.

title: Add a check
steps: On a temporary product, adds a check row with `lathe check add-check`.
Runs lathe check.
expected_result: Expects the row in data/check.jsonl and its problem reported on the aggregate with no command.

title: Add a product's own checks
steps: On a temporary product, adds a house check with the product's product_id and runs lathe check, then fixes what it finds.
Adds a check named like Lathe's, one whose query fails, and a checks key in lathe.config.json.
expected_result: Expects the house check last, its problem gone once fixed, the name refused naming lathe/data/check.jsonl, the failing query an error while others run, and the config key refused.

title: Keep each level of the spec a useful size
steps: On a temporary product, sets low limits with `lathe product-setting set-limits` and runs lathe check.
Raises the limits, adds a use case and ungroups a lone requirement, then checks again.
expected_result: Expects too many children, too many entities and lone children warned of, then none.

title: Review every problem of a product
steps: In Chromium, over a copy of this repo's data, opens the product's Checks page, adds an unused view to a data file while it is open, opens that problem's record and goes back, and follows the check's code.
expected_result: Expects the counts and groups errors first, the new errors (the unused view and the strict product's gap) shown without a reload, and the check's page.

title: Report pattern rule tests that count nowhere and silent manual files
steps: On a temporary product, adds a pattern rule test in a domain that does not follow the pattern, and a manual test whose file does not name it.
Runs lathe check.
expected_result: Expects the pattern rule test reported as an error naming its domain, and the silent manual file a warning.

title: Review the essential records with fresh eyes
steps: Lists the complete product's essential records.
Reads the check-and-fix skill, which has the Agent hold each record to the domain-expert test.
expected_result: Expects the records listed alone by domain, and the skill to list what fails with why for the Owner and change no essential record on that alone.

title: Make the product's check strict
steps: On a temporary product with warnings and gaps, makes its check strict with `lathe product-setting set-strict-check` accepting its warnings; a count above them is refused.
Runs lathe check, then accepts one warning fewer and runs it again.
expected_result: Expects the check to say it is strict, to fail on the gaps whatever it accepts, to pass the accepted warnings, and to fail with a strict-check error once it has more warnings than it accepts.

title: Set the product's technology words
steps: Runs the command on a temporary product that holds the records it works on, as the Owner or an Agent would.
Reads the data the command changed.
Runs the command again so that it breaks a rule of its aggregate.
expected_result: Expects the change as asked, and the second run refused with every reason and nothing changed.

title: Change a check
steps: On a temporary product, adds a check of its own, then changes its severity and its query with `lathe check change-check`.
Tries to change one of Lathe's own checks.
expected_result: Expects the next check to run the check as changed, and Lathe's own check refused, naming it as read-only.

title: Remove a check

Tries to remove one of Lathe's own checks.
expected_result: Expects the next check not to run the removed check, and Lathe's own check refused.
